title: pvResampleToImage
body:
## pvResampleToImage

Samples the input's point and cell arrays onto a new uniform image (vtkImageData) with SamplingDimensions points along x, y and z, spanning the input bounds (UseInputBounds, ParaView default) or custom SamplingBounds. Values are interpolated at the image points by a probe filter, so cell arrays also become point arrays, and points outside the input get 0 in the vtkValidPointMask array. Use it to convert unstructured results to a regular grid for image writers, volume rendering or pvHistogram2D; resample probes onto an existing mesh instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Memory grows with the product of the dimensions: the default 100 × 100 × 100 is a million points per array.
- Sampling is point-wise without averaging, so features smaller than the spacing can be missed.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ResampleToImage`. Identity: `filters/ResampleToImage`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset whose data will be probed. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SamplingBounds` | Custom probing bounds | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |
| `SamplingDimensions` | How many linear samples we want along each axis | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `UseInputBounds` | Use input bounds or custom ones? | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvResampleToImage",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
